$comment: Applied verbatim by scripts/sync-heroui-pro.ts after the copy. Each patch must match exactly once or the sync fails loudly — on a version bump that failure is the signal to re-check whether upstream fixed it. Patches satisfy this app's compiler policy and its bundle policy; none of them change what a component renders.

patches.reason: TS6133 under noUnusedLocals: upstream imports ReactNode but never uses it.
TS6133 under noUnusedLocals: upstream imports RefObject but never uses it.

Bundle policy (U03): upstream imports Shiki's full entry at module scope, which pulls ~11MB of grammars and 217 chunks into every route that touches Markdown. Highlighting already runs inside an async effect behind a plain <pre> fallback, so moving the import into that same effect changes when Shiki loads, not what the block renders.

Bundle policy (U03): second half of the Shiki deferral above — the highlighter is resolved on demand inside the existing try, so an import failure lands in the existing catch and falls back to the unhighlighted block.
TS6133 under noUnusedLocals: dead refs — dragStartPointRef is never touched, and draggingRef is only read by the equally dead lastDragPoint local removed below.
patches.find:
const dragStartPointRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const draggingRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

patches.reason: TS6133 under noUnusedLocals: dead local, never read.
TS6133 under noUnusedParameters: onNestedDrag ignores its event.
TS6133 under noUnusedParameters: onNestedRelease ignores its event.
